sample_unit: primary care providers completing burnout survey (19 with pre/post documentation time data)

links.outcome: Documentation time per encounter and provider burnout (OLBI) after ambient scribe deployment
links.effect: Documentation time fell 28.8% (1.8 min; 95% CI 1.4-2.2). High DAX use had lower OLBI sub-score (MD -2.1; CI -3.8 to -0.4) but not total burnout (MD -3.0; CI -6.4 to 0.3).
links.quote: After DAX™ implementation average documentation time in notes per encounter was significantly reduced by 28.8% (1.8 min; 95% CI 1.4-2.2).

screen.reason: Observational study evaluating the real-world deployment of ambient voice documentation technology (DAX) on provider documentation burden and burnout.
